headline: The co-op shelf can now prove a human played it
lede: PLAICRAFT S1's machine half lands: SHORT ORDER SHOUT, BOMB DEFUSE and RALLY CO-DRIVER each drove their real consent gate, recorder-at-seed-birth and upload path on a phone-shaped browser, landed takes in the store, and replay-verified against the sim — with declined, silent and mid-run-revoke consent axes proven, and a planted mutant caught red at the last-moment strip.

notes.text: #2757 merged — npm run cooptakes: 46/46 live checks (natural game-overs only, honest seat labels incl. Rally's live #2058 opt-out, clocked voice tracks), Vercel green on the merge SHA.
